snippet.text: theorem thetaStress_identity {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsOpen S) (h C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles) (n : ℕ) (hF : SlowStressSupport.Smooth S (thetaDensity h C f n)) {w : InnerPoint} (hX : 0 < w.1) (heta : w.2 ∈ S) : Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * partialX (thetaStress h C f n) w + 2 * thetaStress h C f n w / Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) = -(Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) / C * angularCoefficient h f n w)
